_comment: Goblin keep-alive (services/goblinManagerService.js). ONE node runs it: the one whose hostname equals controllerHost. Every pollIntervalMs it reads each Goblin's /playback-status; a stopped non-empty queue is started again, and a Goblin that comes back (or shows an empty queue) gets its staged show playlist (role 'show' in data/goblin-playlists.json). Never restarts goblin.service or reboots; at most one start per Goblin per minute (floor not configurable); never during a cast or another command. A Stop from Video Control holds a screen dark stopHoldMs (body holdMinutes overrides). Toggle: POST /video-library/api/goblins/keepalive {enabled}. Status: GET same path. Env MB_GOBLIN_KEEPALIVE=on|off overrides this file.
